retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast triptych layout featuring three square monochrome portraits framed by bold, distressed display type and ultra-wide tracked secondary text.
excludeWhen: soft or romantic themes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, black-background composition featuring three square grayscale photographic panels in a horizontal row. Above the panels, a large, heavy sans-serif title is overlaid with a hand-drawn, chalky graphic element. Below the panels, a secondary title is set in a wide-tracked, elegant serif font.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal alignment of three equal-sized square frames
Contrast between heavy, distressed display type and delicate, wide-tracked serif type
Monochrome photographic subjects against a solid black field
Visual tension created by the overlapping hand-drawn 'W' element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three square portraits occupy the horizontal center, flanked by large-scale typography above and small-scale typography below.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central triptych of square images serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large textured title, moves down through the three portraits from left to right, and finishes on the wide-tracked text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of solid black negative space at the top and bottom to frame the central content.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high contrast between deep blacks and bright whites.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy geometric sans-serif and classical serif
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses ultra-bold, slightly irregular edges to simulate print distress
Secondary text uses high-contrast strokes with sharp serifs
Extreme letter spacing (tracking) for the bottom text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first letter of the main title is overlaid with a large, white, chalk-textured gestural stroke
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy, textured display sans-serif paired with delicate, wide-tracked traditional serif.

avoid: Centered tracking for the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy, blocky foundation for the main title.
Classic serif structure for the wide-tracked footer text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black canvas with three identical square frames arranged horizontally in the center. Inside each frame, place a high-contrast monochrome silhouette portrait of a person with textured hair, showing different angles (profile, three-quarters, back).
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, heavy, muted-red sans-serif title across the top, slightly overlapping the frames. Apply a rough, chalky white texture over the first letter. At the very bottom, add a line of white serif text with extreme letter spacing that spans the width of the triptych.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly three square monochrome images?
Is the bottom text extremely wide-tracked?
Does the main title have a distressed, textured appearance?

adjustableVariables: Accent color of the main title
Subject matter within the three square frames
Tracking width of the footer text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Perfect horizontal alignment of the triptych
avoid: Standard tracking on the footer text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the triptych frames are perfectly square
Verify the white chalk element looks hand-drawn
Check that the bottom text is legible despite extreme tracking
Confirm the background is pure black (#000000)
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid Black Background + [3 Square Monochrome Portraits] + [Heavy Distressed Sans-Serif Title] + [Wide-Tracked Serif Footer]
